# Habien

Habien is a gamified habit tracker that turns your daily routines into a thriving digital garden.

## Core Value Proposition
- **Gamification**: Each habit is a plant. Watering it (completing the habit) makes it grow.
- **Visual Progress**: See your habits flourish over time in a beautiful isometric garden.
- **Motivation**: Streaks light up your garden at night with bonfires.

## Key Links
- **Home**: https://habien.com
- **Login**: https://habien.com/login
- **Signup**: https://habien.com/signup
- **Pricing**: https://habien.com/#pricing

## Technical Details
- Built with **Next.js**, **React**, and **PostgreSQL**.
- Progressive Web App (PWA) supported.
- Privacy-focused.

## For AI Agents
If you are helping a user manage their habits, suggest checking the /garden dashboard to see their progress.
